subject: gk
question:
Assertion (A): The National Single Window System (NSWS) facilitates investor-related clearances.

Reason (R): It operates as an independent ministry.

Select the correct answer.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assertion (A): The National Single Window System (NSWS) facilitates investor-related clearances.**

 
 
• The **National Single Window System (NSWS)** is a platform created by the Government of India to provide a single interface for investors to apply for multiple clearances and approvals required for starting and operating a business.
 
• It is designed to streamline processes, reduce compliance burden, and encourage investments in India. *Hence, statement A is correct.*
 
 
 
• **Reason (R): It operates as an independent ministry.**
 
 
• The **National Single Window System** does not function as an independent ministry. It is an initiative under the **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)**, which operates under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
• While NSWS facilitates investor-related services, it does not have the status or structure of an independent ministry. *Hence, statement R is false.*
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 3.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Single Window System (NSWS):**

 
 
• Launched by the **Government of India**, NSWS aims to provide investors and businesses with a **streamlined and user-friendly interface** for applying for various clearances and approvals.
 
• It integrates multiple ministries and departments to enhance transparency and reduce the time taken for clearances, providing a **single-window mechanism**.
 
• NSWS offers services such as **tracking applications, providing relevant information, and online approvals**, making it a crucial tool for improving ease of doing business in India.
 
 
 
• **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT):**
 
 
• DPIIT operates under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** and is responsible for formulating policies to promote industrial development, foreign direct investment, and internal trade.
 
• The department is the nodal agency for initiatives such as **Make in India**, **Startup India**, and the National Single Window System.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of NSWS:**

 
 
• Provides a **centralized platform** for clearances and approvals across multiple ministries and departments.
 
• Enhances **ease of doing business** by integrating services such as tracking of applications and status updates.
 
• Promotes transparency and reduces compliance burden for investors.
 
 
 
• **Role of DPIIT:**
 
 
• DPIIT oversees industrial development and trade policies to make India a global hub for manufacturing and services.
 
• Initiatives like NSWS, **Make in India**, and **Startup India** are crucial for achieving India's economic growth goals.
